body:
Agents change a design only through a proposal the human accepts, so no run may write a design file directly. Files in the repo are watched by default, so without this an agent could skip the visual check.

### Do

- Refuse `write`, `remove`, `move` and file patches on the designs folder, for every run kind, in `lockdown`. The refusal says that designs change through the design agent. A work run can't propose a settings-style change to one either.
- Agents can still read these files.
- Update Spec 14 §1, and record this in a decision.

### Acceptance

- Tests: each of the four write paths is refused in a work run, a batched file patch with one design file changes nothing, and `read` still works.

### Left out

The design agent's own proposal path, and changes made outside Solace. A hand edit of a design file on disk isn't handled here.
title: design: agents can't write designs
